archive.description: Polarimetric archive with recoverable Stokes Q/U (npol>=4 or calibrated)

threshold_sigma.description: Cutoff threshold when selecting PA bins (-t)

guess_smooth_bins.description: Smoothing window (phase bins) used to stabilize the first guess (-smooth)

include.description: Pulse-longitude degree ranges to include in the fit, 'deg0:deg1' each (--include)

exclude.description: Pulse-longitude degree ranges to exclude from the fit, 'deg0:deg1' each (--exclude)

opm.description: Pulse-longitude degree ranges dominated by an orthogonal polarization mode, 'deg0:deg1' each (-o)

use_beta.description: Vary the impact angle beta instead of the line-of-sight colatitude zeta (--use_beta)

residuals.description: Save post-fit residuals as a text artifact: psi (position angle) or stokes (Q/U)
